educationalGoal: Learning objective of this course is learning how to improve existing idea for creation of innovation. For that, students should learn the innovation method by SRI(Stanford Research Institute).
advice: In this class, students learn how to make an innovation. KIT has a partnership with SRI. SRI is the best innovative institute all over the world. It developed innovative products and service such as a coumputer mouse, GUI ,URL , SIRI in iphone. And, SRI has developed the method for creation of Innovation. It's NABC framework and value creation forum. Students can get an ability to make an innovation with these method through this class.
